candidate_recommendation_for_sealed_eval.critic_recommendation: Option A (T1). T3 = T1 + crop. The crop adds no demonstrated gain, its bootstrap is wider (lower CI bound -0.005 vs +0.007), and it changes more parameters, which raises fork risk. Its better mel->NV mean is not reliable at this CI width. Keep T3 as a documented alternative, not the default.
